**The Issue:**

**Why this works:**
- `digits[-1::-2]` selects every other digit starting from the rightmost, getting the odd positions from right (which should NOT be doubled)
- `digits[-2::-2]` selects every other digit starting from the second-to-last, getting the even positions from right (which SHOULD be doubled)
- Together, they now correctly implement the Luhn algorithm
